name: Account Report 36
definition: Reports to a corporate on the actual set-up of the account, related services and mandates.

UnderlyingMasterAgreement.name: Underlying Master Agreement
UnderlyingMasterAgreement.definition: Account contract established between the organisation or the group to which the organisation belongs, and the account servicer. This contract has to be applied for the new account to be opened and maintained.

Group.name: Group
Group.definition: Definition of a group of parties.

ReferenceAccount.name: Reference Account
ReferenceAccount.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the account used as a reference for the opening of another account.

BalanceTransferAccount.name: Balance Transfer Account
BalanceTransferAccount.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the account where to transfer the balance.

TransferAccountServicerIdentification.name: Transfer Account Servicer Identification
TransferAccountServicerIdentification.definition: Identification of the transfer account servicer.

ContractDates1Rule.definition: ContractDates/TargetGoLiveDate and ContractDates/GoLiveDate should not be used as part of an account closing process.

ContractDates2Rule.definition: ContractDates/ClosingDate should not be used as part of an account opening and maintenance process.
